note: Chelban et al. (2020) explicitly report that epilepsy can present in the absence of overt hypomyelination and diffuse hypomyelination can present without seizures in NKX6-2-related disease.

evidence.text: Chelban et al. (2020) demonstrated that in NKX6-2-related disorder, phenotypes with epilepsy in the absence of overt hypomyelination as well as diffuse hypomyelination without seizures can occur.

source.title: Genetic and phenotypic characterization of NKX6‐2‐related spastic ataxia and hypomyelination
source.quote: The phenotypic and neuroimaging expression in NKX6-2 is described and it is shown that phenotypes with epilepsy in the absence of overt hypomyelination and diffuse hypomyelination without seizures can occur.
